summary: st demo play waits for its daemon's health answer before seeding, instead of reading the agents roster, which says "not ready" until the daemon first publishes it; on a loaded machine the demo no longer stops with "the demo's daemon did not start"

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, migrations or wire changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Only `st demo play`'s own start-up wait changes; it still waits up to a minute for the daemon and says so in its play log.
